title: Ship Your Car Anywhere in the US
subtitle: Moving across the country? Bought a car out of state? We connect you with professional carriers for safe, on-time delivery with real-time updates.

steps.title: Tell Us About Your Car
steps.desc: Enter your VIN or vehicle details and where it needs to go.

steps.title: Get Your Quote
steps.desc: We respond within 1 hour with a competitive, all-inclusive price.

steps.title: We Pick It Up
steps.desc: A vetted carrier picks up your vehicle at the scheduled time.

steps.title: Track & Receive
steps.desc: Get status updates via text and email until delivery is complete.

bol.title: Important: Bill of Lading (BOL) Inspection
bol.text: Upon delivery, you or your representative MUST inspect the vehicle together with the carrier driver and sign the Bill of Lading (BOL). By signing the BOL, you confirm the vehicle's condition at delivery. Any damage claims filed after signing the BOL without notation are the recipient's responsibility.

quoteSubtitle: No obligation. We respond within 1 hour.

faqs.a: Most routes take 3-7 business days. Coast-to-coast can be 7-10 days. We give you an estimated window at booking.

faqs.q: Is my car insured during transport?
faqs.a: Yes. Every carrier we work with carries cargo insurance. We verify active coverage before assigning any load.

faqs.q: Can I ship a non-running vehicle?
faqs.a: Yes. Let us know in the quote form. Non-running vehicles require a winch or forklift for loading, which may affect pricing.

faqs.q: Open or enclosed — what should I choose?
faqs.a: Open transport is the most common and affordable option. Enclosed is recommended for luxury, classic, or high-value vehicles.
